# PickTheRobot

> Two-track rules-based matcher: **home robot vacuums** and **business robots** (warehouse, commercial cleaning, restaurant). Not a vendor, concierge, or lab-test review site.

PickTheRobot is a buyer-side recommendation utility. Recommendations are informational; users should verify pricing and fit with retailers or vendors directly. Some product links may be affiliates.

## Primary actions

- [Home — choose a track](https://picktherobot.com/#tracks): Home robot vacuums vs business robots.
- [Robot vacuum matcher](https://picktherobot.com/robot-vacuums): Floors, pets, mopping, budget → ranked models from public specs.
- [Business matcher](https://picktherobot.com/business): Warehouse, commercial cleaning, or restaurant → robot type, buy vs lease vs RaaS, ranked vendors.

## Home track

- [Robot vacuums](https://picktherobot.com/robot-vacuums): Separate catalog of product models (not the B2B vendor index). Scoring is spec/fit rules, not RTINGS-style lab tests.

## Business categories

- [Warehouse robots](https://picktherobot.com/warehouse-robots): AMRs, AGVs, picking assist, pallet movers.
- [Commercial cleaning robots](https://picktherobot.com/cleaning-robots): Office, retail, and industrial autonomous scrubbers/vacuums — not home robot vacuums.
- [Restaurant robots](https://picktherobot.com/restaurant-robots): Serving, bussing, kitchen, and reception robots.

Educational guides (robot types, key definitions, vendors, FAQs) on each category page: append `#guide` to the URL (e.g. https://picktherobot.com/warehouse-robots#guide).

## Buyer checklists (free, printable)

## Methodology

- [How PickTheRobot scores robots](https://picktherobot.com/methodology): Rules-based weights, home-vacuum spec matching, sponsorship/affiliate disclosure, and limits.

## Vendors (business)

- [All vendors](https://picktherobot.com/vendors): Browse vendor profiles with outbound links to official sites.

- [Humanoid robots hub](https://picktherobot.com/humanoid-robots): Readiness labels and when deployable AMRs/scrubbers are the practical choice.
